canonical_project: Bitdeer first data center in Turkmenistan (White City Ashgabat MoU)
owner: Bitdeer Technologies Group (Singapore) with Ministry of Energy, Ministry of Communications, Ministry of Finance and Economy of Turkmenistan
notes: On 25 May 2026 at the White City Ashgabat conference Bitdeer announced plans to establish the first state-of-the-art data center / high-performance computing and data center in Turkmenistan, following an MoU with three ministries (Energy, Communications, Finance and Economy); official portal post 100160 lists Bitdeer as an international participant 'pioneering AI-based industrial and data-center solutions'. MoU/announcement level only - no site, land, grid connection, contract or construction evidence - recorded as announced prospect per methodology (do not count as facility). News Central Asia notes the Türkmenbaşy-Awaza Caspian zone as the strongest potential site (connectivity context, unconfirmed).
